description: This file is a PHP script used during the pre-migration phase of a vtiger CRM installation or upgrade. It initiates database health verification, manages database backup and copy operations, integrates HTML for a web interface, includes JavaScript functions for user interactions, and handles session data related to migration configuration.

methods.name: fixDBHealth
methods.description: JavaScript function that triggers a database health check and attempts to fix table types, updating the user interface based on success or failure.

methods.name: viewDBReport
methods.description: JavaScript function to open a window displaying the database health report.

methods.name: getDbDump
methods.description: JavaScript function to initiate a database dump download.

methods.name: doDBCopy
methods.description: JavaScript function to perform a database copy operation by sending the required parameters to the server.

methods.name: showCopyPopup
methods.description: JavaScript function to display the database copy configuration popup.
